opportunities.title: Research Awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications not considered. Early career researchers welcome.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, history of collecting and intellectual enquiry. Includes named awards (Marion Wilson, Joan Pye, Hugh Chapman).

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Research and travel awards within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, including the Beatrice de Cardi fund (Arabian archaeology), Janet Arnold fund (dress and textiles), Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler travel awards, and William Lambarde travel awards.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required for Morris applications.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church buildings and monuments. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required for Linda Parry applications. Applied via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research. Applications are made through the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
